title: 飽和雲圏の測位者：灰色の天球と信号の残滓
author: 鷹野 シン

en.title: The Surveyor of the Saturated Cloud Sphere: Grey Firmament and Signal Vestiges
en.premise: Humanity is permitted to survive only under strictly controlled artificial weather conditions. Helios, a weather observation technician, discovers a discrepancy in his data: a faint pulse emanating from an "ancient lighthouse" that exists on no modern map. The signal reveals the coordinates of the "True Sky," a secret long suppressed by the management system. Guided by a clandestine repair shop that opens only on rainy days, Helios begins to decode forbidden records etched into the very composition of the atmosphere.

zh.title: 饱和云圈的测位者：灰色天球与信号残迹
zh.premise: 人类仅被允许在受控的人造气象条件下生存。气象观测技师埃利奥斯从观测数据的偏差中，侦测到了一个在现行数字地图上本不该存在的“古老灯塔”所发出的微弱脉冲信号。而该信号，正指向管理系统一直试图掩盖的“真实天空”的坐标。循着仅在雨天开业的地下修理店，埃利奥斯开始解读刻在大气组成中的禁忌记录。
